pipeline_name: Pump Station 06- Qassim PS Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: Keep. Real, distinct MGSE Phase-2 (Package 2) sales-gas transmission line; length 226 km and diameter 46 in are high-confidence. No de-dup needed.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Real. The row is the 'Central Region Pipeline' of Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 2 — a new 226 km / 46-inch line laid parallel to the existing AYQS-1 / 'East-West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1' from Pump Station 06 near Riyadh to the Qassim power plant. Three independent trade/contractor surfaces confirm it: DMS Projects ('226 kilometers of 46-inch pipeline on the East-West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1', client Saudi Aramco, status Completed), Lamar Industrial contractor page ('226 km', '46-inch', 'from Pump Station 06 near Riyadh to the Qassim Power Plant', built parallel to AYQS-1), and BlackRidge Research (Central Region package, 226 km of 46in, part of the Phase-2 loop; MGS capacity raised 8.4->12.5 bcf/d, EPC completed 2021). CLASSIFICATION: Correct — large-diameter (46in) sales-gas transmission trunk within the Master Gas System, not gathering/process/plant-internal, and it is gas (not oil/NGL). DUPLICATE: Not a duplicate. It is a NEW parallel loop, physically distinct from the pre-existing AYQS/A47-Yanbu family (GEM P1897 A47-Yanbu, P1903 AY-1 KP943-Riyadh) it parallels, and distinct from its sibling MGSE Phase-2 packages already in GEM (P7712 Western Region PS07->PS11, P7714/P7715 Eastern Region Shedgum->Riyadh). ATTRIBUTION: Owner/operator Saudi Aramco — confirmed (DMS lists client Saudi Aramco). Note EPC contractor was Arkad Engineering & Construction (won the three main MGS-2 pipeline packages, ~USD 1.3bn total; Lamar was a sub-contractor) — contractor, not owner. SPEC (length/diameter): 226 km and 46 in agree across DMS + Lamar + BlackRidge = HIGH. See separate spec concern for cost/date conflicts.

validity.recommendation: Adjudicate cost and start date. GEM SegmentCost USD 364,000,000 is the estimated PACKAGE BUDGET (BlackRidge/METenders family); Lamar states an awarded contract value of USD 220.38M — different figures for different scopes; treat 364M as estimated budget, medium confidence. Keep StartYear1=2021 (better corroborated) but note Lamar's conflicting 2018.
validity.researcher_notes: COST: GEM SegmentCost = USD 364,000,000. The 'estimated budget of almost $364 million' phrasing appears in the METenders/BlackRidge family (likely one origin) and is corroborated on BlackRidge. The actual EPC contractor page (Lamar) states a contract value of 'USD 220.38 million'. These are not the same measure — 364M reads as the estimated overall package budget, 220.38M as one awarded EPC contract value — so the GEM figure is defensible as an estimated budget but is single-family-sourced and conflicts with the contractor's own number; tier medium. Recommend labeling it estimated budget and swapping the broken METenders ref (403/value-not-found) for BlackRidge (contains '364'). DATE: GEM StartYear1=2021. Trade consensus (BlackRidge, METenders, the MEED MGS-package coverage) is that Phase-2 EPC works completed in 2021 (capacity 8.4->12.5 bcf/d). Lamar's page instead says 'Awarded 2015, Completed 2018', which likely reflects Lamar's own sub-scope or is mislabeled. Keep 2021 as the operating start (better corroborated across independent sources) but flag the Lamar 2018 discrepancy.

fills.researcher_notes: Owner [ref] was blank. Saudi Aramco is the owner/operator: DMS Projects lists the client as Saudi Aramco and BlackRidge attributes the MGSE Phase-2 program to Aramco. Aramco 100%. (Arkad Engineering was the EPC contractor, not an owner.)

Existing Status [ref] (Lamar) returned 200 but did not contain 'operating'. Replace with better support: BlackRidge states Phase-2 EPC works completed in 2021 and DMS lists status 'Completed' -> pipeline is operating. Both name the Central Region 226km/46in package.

routes.corridor_desc: The line runs from Pump Station 06, described as 'near Riyadh' on the East-West / AYQS-1 ('East-West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1') corridor, northwest toward the Qassim region (Buraydah/Unaizah) terminating at the Qassim power plant, ~226 km. It was built parallel to the existing AYQS-1 line, so its corridor closely follows that established Riyadh-region->Qassim gas corridor. Bound is LOOSE at the start: the exact ground position of Pump Station 06 is not published in a citable source (only 'near Riyadh'), so its coordinates are left null rather than fabricated. The Qassim end is defensible to the Buraydah/Al-Qassim area (~26.3N, 43.97E) from the named 'Qassim power plant' terminus, but is approximate, not a sourced pipeline coordinate.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from Lamar ('from Pump Station 06 near Riyadh to the Qassim Power Plant', parallel to AYQS-1) and DMS ('on the East-West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1'). No traced geometry is published, so this is a corridor suggestion only, low accuracy. Start coordinate left null to avoid fabricating Pump Station 06's exact location; Qassim end coordinate is an approximate for the named Buraydah/Al-Qassim power-plant area, not a sourced coordinate. No coordinates invented.

summary: P7711 real, distinct MGSE Phase-2 Central Region 226km/46in Aramco sales-gas trunk (Riyadh-region PS06 -> Qassim, parallel to AYQS-1); confirmed (caveat) + spec concern on cost (364M budget vs Lamar 220.38M) and 2021-vs-2018 date; owner+status refs staged; route corridor low accuracy.
